name: White Pine Camps (White Pine Programs Summer Camp)
description_short: An all-outdoor nature camp in York, Maine for ages 4–17, with weekly day programs at Coastal Ridge Elementary School, a leadership week with a Thursday overnight, a traveling camp, a counselor-in-training program, and backcountry expeditions for teens. Activities center on bushcraft, shelter building, nature journaling, map and compass, and community-building.
refund_policy_summary: $50 deposit ($100 for expeditions) is non-refundable and non-transferable. A $50 administrative fee applies to any cancellation. Cancelling 60–31 days before the start date may get a refund of 50% of tuition, minus the fee. Cancelling 2 weeks or less before the start gets no refund. Week transfers are not possible within 2 weeks of the start date. Families get a full refund if financial aid can't be granted or if the camp decides it is not the right fit for a child with special needs.
special_needs_notes: Many campers have IEPs or 504 plans. Families should call 207-361-1911 or email samm@whitepineprograms.org as soon as they register to talk about fit. The camp cannot provide one-on-one support, but outside aides (for example, a school-provided ed-tech) may come with the child. Behavior that puts others at risk may mean a child cannot continue in the program.
